solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Brussels baker flips, dismissing British discovery

parts.note: Brussels is the seat of the European Union, so it stands for EU

indicators.note: dismissing sends away, so a letter is taken out of the reversed baker
something that flips turns over, so the word baker is read backwards

parts.note: taken as the word itself, then turned round

explanation.surface: A Belgian baker loses his temper and throws out a British find.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flips' turns BAKER into REKAB; 'dismissing' then drops its B to leave REKA.
explanation.definitionFit: The cry Archimedes gave on solving his problem, used here as a name for a finding or breakthrough.

clue.text: Starter in athletics getting no race is getting on

indicators.note: the starter of a word is its opening letter, here taken from athletics
no means without, so letters are removed from getting

parts.note: the TT is the Tourist Trophy, the Isle of Man motorcycle race

explanation.surface: An athletics starter finds there is no race to start, a wry sporting moment.
explanation.walkthrough: The race is the TT, the Isle of Man motorcycle races; 'getting on' is the definition, while the earlier 'getting' is the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone getting on is growing old, an idiom for advancing in years.

clue.text: Explosive information: made energy absorbing one cow's smelly gas

parts.note: nitro is short for nitroglycerine, an explosive
gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: absorbing takes something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: made means did, as in did a job
I is the Roman numeral one
an ox is a bovine animal; the 's is just possessive
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A tip-off about explosives leads to a smelly gas coming from a cow, like a farmyard scare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'absorbing' puts IOX inside DIDE after its first D, making DIOXIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: This brown gas is a pollutant with a sharp, acrid odour, so it is a smelly gas.

clue.text: Occasionally idler cleans empty cavity, in fairness

indicators.note: occasionally means every so often, so only alternate letters of idler cleans are taken
an empty word has its inside removed, leaving only the outside letters of cavity

explanation.surface: A lazy worker sometimes cleans out a hollow, fairly enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Occasionally' takes the even letters of IDLER CLEANS, DECEN; 'empty' leaves CY from CAVITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Both suggest proper, reasonable behaviour; in all decency means in all fairness.

clue.text: Cast miracle comeback right for constant interruption to Coronation Street, say?

indicators.note: cast means thrown or moulded into a new shape, so the letters are rearranged
right for constant means one letter replaces another in the fodder

parts.note: C is the usual symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

explanation.surface: A soap actor's miraculous return is interrupted again and again.
explanation.walkthrough: Coronation Street is a long-running British TV soap on a commercial channel. 'for' swaps one C of MIRACLE COMEBACK for R, and 'Cast' rearranges the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause in a programme on commercial television for advertisements, the example being the soap.

clue.text: Discovered every opening in part of Manhattan

indicators.note: dis-covered means with the cover removed, so the outer letters of every go

parts.note: a mouth is an opening, as of a cave or river

explanation.surface: Someone finds every way in to a district of New York.
explanation.walkthrough: The Manhattan here is the cocktail of whiskey and sweet vermouth, not the borough.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified wine that is an ingredient of the Manhattan cocktail.

clue.text: A bar area contains ordinary juice that could be healing

indicators.note: contains means holds inside, so one letter goes within the other pieces

parts.note: a lever is a bar used to prise
O is the abbreviation for ordinary, as in O level

explanation.surface: A pub area serves an ordinary drink with healing powers.
explanation.definitionFit: The sap of this succulent plant is used to soothe burns and skin, a medicinal juice.

clue.text: Company meeting gets into papers — a tricky situation

indicators.note: gets into means enters, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper
AGM is an annual general meeting of a company

explanation.surface: A shareholders' meeting makes the newspapers, causing a tricky situation for the firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A bog is the literal sense; figuratively it is a predicament hard to escape.

clue.text: Old layer absorbs space in full view

indicators.note: absorbs takes in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: ply is a layer, as in three-ply wood
an en is a printing space, half an em

explanation.surface: An old hen soaks up space in plain sight of everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old layer' suggests an aged hen; layer is in fact PLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Done publicly and without concealment, in plain sight.

clue.text: Thing sticking out in river

definitions.meaning: a projection on a rotating shaft that pushes another part
the river that flows through Cambridge

explanation.surface: Something juts out of the water.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine part projecting from a revolving shaft; also a Cambridge river.

clue.text: Exercise rank when I will supplant first European in line

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise

indicators.note: to supplant is to replace, so one letter takes the place of another

parts.note: a degree is a rank or grade

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word European

explanation.surface: A military exercise where rank yields to the individual in the ranks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will supplant' puts I in place of the first E of DEGREE, giving DIGREE.
explanation.definitionFit: A line is a lineage or ancestry, the record of descent.

clue.text: Keep on missing subscriber

indicators.note: missing means without, so the letters for on are dropped

parts.note: to keep a date or anniversary is to observe it, keep it in mind
re means on or concerning

explanation.surface: Carry on even though a subscriber is absent.
explanation.definitionFit: A subscriber to a club or society is one who belongs to it.

clue.text: Hold delivery there, Aggers' cagoule twisted on most of bat

indicators.note: on means placed next to, so the two pieces sit side by side
most of a word is all but its last letter, so bat loses its end
twisted means bent out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cricket commentator Aggers' raincoat gets twisted up during a delivery.
explanation.walkthrough: Aggers is Jonathan Agnew, a BBC cricket commentator; 'Hold delivery' is luggage from an aircraft's hold, not a bowler's ball.
explanation.definitionFit: The rotating belt in an airport where checked luggage from the aircraft is returned to passengers.

clue.text: Rejected silver surfer's opening — empty talk

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so in a down clue it is read backwards

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: a word's opening is its first letter

explanation.surface: A surfer turned down for silver talks nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle chatter, as in all hot air.

clue.text: Nearly stream pop star in fool's errand?

indicators.note: nearly means almost all, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a jet is a stream of liquid or gas
Sting is the stage name of the English singer, formerly of The Police

explanation.surface: A pop star is almost swept along in a pointless mission.
explanation.definitionFit: A court fool's business is making jokes, so joking is his errand, hence the question mark.

clue.text: English bird has compassion, no power for a long time

parts.note: a tern is a seabird

indicators.note: no means without, so a letter is removed

parts.note: pity is compassion
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: An English bird with feeling but no strength lasts a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: Hyperbole for a very long wait; strictly time without end.

clue.text: All French drink, sharing last of dregs and tumbling

parts.note: tous is French for all

indicators.note: the two words share one letter where they meet, so it is written only once

parts.note: a sling is a drink of spirit, water and sugar

indicators.note: the last of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Everyone drinks together down to the dregs, ending in a tumble.
explanation.walkthrough: TOUS and SLING overlap on the S that ends 'dregs', so that S is counted once.
explanation.definitionFit: To tumble hair is to rumple it, so ruffling or mussing is the sense.

clue.text: Bus route after school

indicators.note: after places one piece behind the other

parts.note: a high school is a type of school
a way is a route

explanation.surface: A bus route going home after school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bus route' reads as one phrase, but Bus alone is the definition: in computing a bus is a data highway.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing, a bus is the shared pathway along which data travels between components.

clue.text: Acceptable to follow western hemisphere for culinary purposes

indicators.note: to follow means to come after, so one piece goes behind the other

parts.note: OK means acceptable

explanation.surface: Something passable follows the western world when it comes to cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'western hemisphere' reads as the Americas; hemisphere belongs with the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A wok is a bowl-shaped Chinese pan, roughly half a sphere, used for cooking.

clue.text: Grand escape hides my turning up in school dress

indicators.note: hides means conceals within, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand
to slip is to escape

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue means read backwards

explanation.surface: A great escape conceals my arrival in school uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'turning up' reads a word from the bottom upward, so it reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleeveless tunic once worn by British schoolgirls as uniform.

clue.text: Source of reassurance provided by MI5 cover?

parts.note: MI5 is Britain's Security Service
a blanket is a bed cover

explanation.surface: MI5 protection as a comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's comfort cloth, and anything that makes someone feel safe.

clue.text: Nark is a weed

definitions.meaning: to nark is to annoy or irritate
a stinging plant that grows wild

explanation.surface: An informer is a pest.
explanation.definitionFit: To irritate someone; also a stinging wild plant.

clue.text: First lady and child promoted north nevertheless

indicators.note: promoted means raised, so in a down clue a letter moves upward

parts.note: Eve is the first woman in the Bible
a son is a child

explanation.surface: The President's wife and her child get promoted northward regardless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'promoted' lifts the N of EVESON two places up, giving EVENSO.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean despite that, in spite of what was said.

clue.text: Rush among ten catching disease

indicators.note: catching means holding, so one piece is caught inside the other

parts.note: in means among
X is the Roman numeral ten
flu is a disease

explanation.surface: A rush occurs among ten people catching an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival in large numbers, a surge or flood.

clue.text: Salespeople backed taking in somewhere posh for drink

indicators.note: taking in means enclosing
backed means turned back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: reps are sales representatives
the Ritz is a famously luxurious London hotel

explanation.surface: Salesmen go back to a fancy hotel for a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A mix of wine and soda water, served as a long drink.

clue.text: Little William's scrapping ends badly

indicators.note: scrapping the ends removes the first and last letters

parts.note: Bill is short for William, and the 's adds an S; the answer also sits inside William's, a coincidence

explanation.surface: Little William scraps badly at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill as an adverb means poorly, as in ill-treated.

clue.text: Drunk's removed seeds

definitions.meaning: having had the pits taken out, as of fruit

explanation.surface: The drunk has removed seeds.
explanation.definitionFit: Very intoxicated; also of fruit, pitted.

clue.text: Leaning towards the West, an island gets breaking news instantly

indicators.note: in an across clue, leaning west means reading right to left

parts.note: a flash is a breaking news bulletin

explanation.surface: A westward island learns breaking news instantly.
explanation.definitionFit: Very quickly, in the space of a flash of light.
